Take-home Message

Diagnosis pattern

Irregular hepatic contour + diffuse nodular distribution + delayed enhancing fibrosis-like areas strongly support cirrhotic remodeling.

Nodule HU

Regenerative nodules and surrounding parenchyma do not differ significantly in attenuation across phases.

Decompensation

Lower normalized liver volume and lower PV/Ao ratio were significant in the decompensated group.

Clinical value

CT helps target biopsy, assess portal hypertension, and risk-stratify beyond laboratory data alone.

CT 判讀流程

  1. 先看肝輪廓：是否有 diffuse irregular margin、capsular distortion、nodular hepatic contour？
  2. 看結節分布：uniform across all lobes 或 focal/uneven？若 uneven，biopsy targeting 應優先針對影像最明顯肝葉。
  3. 看 PP：regenerative nodule margins 通常在 portal venous phase 最清楚，因 fibrotic septa 在此相較低衰減。
  4. 看 DP：低衰減區域是否 delayed enhancement？若有，支持 fibrotic tissue。
  5. 分辨 necrosis-like lesion：楔形或結節狀低衰減且所有 phase 顯影很少，可能為 focal necrosis / ischemic necrosis。
  6. 量化：測 PV/Ao ratio 與 normalized liver volume。
  7. 找 decompensation：ascites、esophageal varices、splenorenal / porto-azygos collaterals、GI/胰臟 edema、jaundice / HE 病史。

Liver volume/body weight47.6 ± 16.8 cm3/kg26.5 ± 16.8 cm3/kg0.038
PV/Ao ratio1.19 ± 0.150.93 ± 0.120.003

這兩個 CT variables 是本研究中唯一顯著區分 compensated 與 decompensated cirrhosis 的影像參數。

  • Regenerative nodules 和 hepatic parenchyma 在各相 HU 無顯著差異。
  • PP 的 mean HU 最高：nodule 133.94 ± 34.8 HU；parenchyma 136.62 ± 29.68 HU。
  • DP 可能使 fibrotic septa 延遲顯影，讓 regenerative nodule margins 變得較不清楚。
  • 造影前低衰減且延遲顯影：支持 fibrosis-like tissue。
  • 低衰減楔形/結節且幾乎不顯影：支持 focal necrosis-like lesion。

Albumin、total bilirubin、ALP、AST、ALT、GGT 在 compensated 與 decompensated groups 間皆無統計顯著差異。本研究因此強調 CT quantitative features 可能比單次血檢更能提示 decompensation risk。

Interpretation Pitfalls

不要只寫 nodular liver

Report 應描述結節分布、PP/DP 顯影特徵、是否有 delayed enhancing fibrotic tissue、PV/Ao ratio、肝體積與門脈高壓徵象。這些資訊才會影響臨床分期與 biopsy planning。

再生結節 vs HCC

本研究中的 regenerative nodules HU 與周圍肝實質相似；若有真正 mass effect、arterial hyperenhancement、washout 或明顯孤立腫塊，仍須另外鑑別肝腫瘤。

低衰減區域

Delayed enhancement 偏 fibrosis；minor/no enhancement 偏 necrosis。不能全部用同一診斷包住。

Ascites effect

Ascites 可能讓 gallbladder indentation 不明顯，因此 absence of indentation 不能排除進展期 fibrosis。

No cut-off

因病例數小，本文未建立 liver volume 或 PV/Ao 的 definitive cutoff。

English: Representative transverse post-contrast computed tomography (CT) images of an irregular liver margin and gallbladder indentation. (A,B) Irregular margin showing nodular hepatic contour. (B) The gallbladder wall is sharply compressed by nodules (arrow). Slice thickness = 2.5 mm, Window = 400 HU, Level = 60 HU.

Fig. 2 - Portal vein-to-aorta ratio measurement

中文：用於測量 portal vein-to-aorta（PV/Ao）ratio 的橫切造影後 CT 影像。門靜脈（箭頭）與主動脈（空心箭頭）於肝門水平測量。本病例在肝門水平量得門靜脈直徑為 6.5 mm，主動脈直徑為 8.4 mm，因此 PV/Ao ratio 為 0.77。

English: Transverse postcontrast CT images to measure the portal vein-to-aorta (PV/Ao) ratio. The portal vein (arrow) and aorta (open arrow) were measured at the level of porta hepatis. In this patient, the diameter of the portal vein and aorta measured at the level of portal hepatis is 6.5 mm and 8.4 mm, respectively, thus the ratio of the portal vein to the aorta is 0.77.

Fig. 3 - Hepatic volume measurement

中文：門脈期（A,C）與動脈期（B）腹腔橫切 CT 影像，用於肝體積測量。(A) 以手動方式沿肝臟邊緣繪製 ROI（綠線），並包含肝內血管。膽囊、後腔靜脈（實心箭頭頭）與肝外門靜脈（空心箭頭頭）不納入計算。(B,C) 胰臟（星號）在動脈期可清楚與肝臟實質區分，但在門脈期中肝臟實質與胰臟無法區分（箭頭）。

English: Portal venous phase (A,C) and arterial phase (B) transverse abdominal CT images for hepatic volume measurement. (A) The liver margin was manually drawn as a region of interest (ROI; green lines), including intrahepatic vasculature. The gallbladder, caudal vena cava (closed arrowhead), and extrahepatic portal vein (open arrowhead) were excluded from calculations. (B,C) The pancreas (asterisk) was clearly distinguished from the hepatic parenchyma in the AP, while the hepatic parenchyma and pancreas were indistinguishable in the PP (arrow).

Fig. 4 - Delayed enhancement of a focal hypoattenuating area

中文：局部低衰減區域具延遲顯影的代表性三相 CT 影像。(A) 造影前。(B) 動脈期。(C) 門脈期。(D) 延遲期。邊界清楚的低衰減區域（箭頭）逐漸顯影，並在延遲期達到最高衰減值。鄰近肝臟實質則在門脈期達到最高衰減值。注意此病灶（箭頭）在延遲期變為與肝實質等衰減。

English: Representative three-phase CT images of focal hypoattenuating area with delayed contrast enhancement. (A) Pre-contrast. (B) AP. (C) PP. (D) DP. The hypoattenuating area with distinct margins (arrows) were gradually enhanced and showed its highest attenuation value at DP. Adjacent hepatic parenchyma showed its highest attenuation value at PP. Note that the lesion (arrow) became iso-attenuating to hepatic parenchyma on DP.

Fig. 5 - Peripheral wedge-shaped hypoattenuating area

中文：周邊楔形低衰減區域的代表性 CT 影像。(A) 造影前。(B) 造影後。注意位於周邊的楔形區域（箭頭）僅有輕微顯影。相較之下，位於腹側的病灶（箭頭頭）為囊性病灶，呈液體衰減值且僅有極少顯影。

English: Representative CT images of a peripheral wedge-shaped hypoattenuating area. (A) Precontrast. (B) Postcontrast. Note that the wedge-shaped area (arrow) located peripherally shows a minor contrast enhancement. In contrast, the ventrally located lesion (arrowhead) was a cystic lesion, which showed fluid attenuation value with minimal enhancement.

Fig. 6 - Esophageal varices

中文：食道靜脈曲張的造影後 CT 影像。(A) 矢狀面。(B) 背側面。注意沿著食道走行的細小彎曲 collateral veins（箭頭）。

English: Post-contrast computed tomography images of esophageal varices. (A), sagittal plane. (B), dorsal plane. Note that tortuous small collateral veins (arrow) along the esophagus.

Clinical Application

Recommended impression

CT findings are consistent with cirrhotic hepatic remodeling, including diffuse nodular hepatic contour, delayed enhancing fibrotic bands/areas, and portal hypertension-related changes. Decreased normalized liver volume and decreased PV/Ao ratio increase concern for a decompensated cirrhotic phase.

Report checklist

肝輪廓、結節分布、PP/DP 顯影、low-attenuation necrosis-like lesions、PV/Ao ratio、liver volume/body weight、ascites、varices/collaterals、GI/胰臟 edema、PVT、biopsy target。
